courses.name: Algorithmic Foundations for Artificial Intelligence
courses.prerequisites: ( CMPSC 132 or CMPSC 122 ) and ( MATH 225 or( MATH 220 and ( MATH 231 or MATH 230 ))) and ( CMPSC 360 or MATH 311W ) and ( STAT 401 or STAT 414 or STAT 418 or EE 465 or STAT 318 )
courses.description: Algorithm design and data structures for machine-learning work; includes classical, randomized and optimization methods.

courses.name: AI Systems and Tools
courses.prerequisites: ( CMPSC 448 or DS 310 ) and A-I 341W and EE 456

courses.name: Introduction to Neural Networks

courses.description: Design and application of neural networks across engineering fields, with hands-on modeling and a final project.

courses.name: Machine Learning and Algorithmic AI

requirements.title: Minor requirements

requirements.title: Department-list electives
requirements.summary: Department-list courses not required by the major; at least three credits at 400-level. List not extracted.

requirements.title: Grade and overlap rules
requirements.summary: C or better in all minor courses; six minor credits must be unique from prescribed major courses.

requirements.title: Entrance requirements
requirements.summary: Complete ((CMPSC 121 and DS 120) or CMPSC 131), plus either CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132. Entrance credits are not added to the 18-credit minor total.

requirements.title: Public directory returns to the bulletin
requirements.summary: The canonical EECS directory identifies the jointly offered AI Engineering minor and links its Learn more entry to the minor bulletin. This is identity/provenance context, not an approved Department List.

requirements.title: Department-list guidance does not establish minor options
requirements.summary: The FAQ refers readers to each major handbook for departmental lists. Its AIE link leads to the AI Engineering BS overview, which does not enumerate the minor Department List or explicitly authorize a BS pool for the minor. No major-to-minor equivalence is inferred.

requirements.title: Prerequisite enforcement and substitution review
requirements.summary: EECS course prerequisites are strictly enforced. Students expecting a course substitution to satisfy a prerequisite must request an override through the enrollment section of LionPATH and are advised to consult their assigned adviser. The minor CMPSC 445 alternative does not itself waive the separately published A-I 410 prerequisites. No private system or form was accessed.

notes: Department-list elective options are not enumerated on the inspected bulletin page; course prerequisites may add preparation outside the minor total.

The minor is available where the required courses are offered; students cannot change campus solely to complete it. This is a University Park-administered engineering minor, not a separate campus degree.
The minor bulletin does not supply a standalone learning-outcomes section. The displayed source-stated objective is paraphrased from Program Description.
No launch date or public syllabus was established. No claim of comprehensive Penn State AI-program inventory is made.
Course descriptions are concise editorial paraphrases; prerequisites preserve the logical alternatives published by the bulletin.
Pilot record; institution ranking/cohort membership is established separately. Null fields indicate unverified facts, not absence.
All five course descriptions, credits and enforced prerequisites were reviewed on permitted subject-catalog pages. Search/bubble endpoints are robots-disallowed and are not refresh sources.
The EECS minor directory links back to the same bulletin without publishing the Department List. The finite approved elective inventory remains unresolved.

A-I 410 currently requires (CMPSC 448 or DS 310), A-I 341W and EE 456. The minor also allows CMPSC 445 in its machine-learning choice; the sources do not establish that this substitutes for the A-I 410 prerequisite. Advising review is needed.

2026-10-11: Corrected the directory URL to the case-sensitive canonical Majors-Minors-Certificates.aspx path published in EECS navigation. The old lowercase request returned unrelated AI BS content. The actual minor directory returns to the bulletin; the advising FAQ AIE handbook link leads to a BS overview without the minor approved list. The remaining gap is missing public minor-list evidence, not a demonstrated access denial.
